verdict.rationale: Tilled documents webhooks that send real-time event notifications to your application. That is a developer building block for constructing your own automation, not a product capability to define rules that trigger actions on events. No rule engine, workflow builder, or event-triggered action configuration appears in the evidence, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Webhooks provide real-time notifications to your application about events occurring on platform.
